capabilities: Browse Hacker News feeds (Top, New, Best, Ask HN, Show HN, Jobs)
Save stories to a reading list note with one click
Create a daily note per day with YAML frontmatter for saved stories
Append configurable tags to every saved story
Open the reader as a sidebar panel or a new tab
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation via BRAT is documented.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to browse Hacker News or capture story links into notes without leaving the app.

relations.evidence: Browse Hacker News top stories directly inside Obsidian.

summary: Hacker News client that browses Top, New, Best, Ask, Show and Jobs feeds in Obsidian and saves stories to a reading list note.
